name: fitia
description: Production monorepo for the unofficial Fitia CLI and MCP server

scripts.build: bun run --filter @fitia/core build && bun run --filter @fitia/cli build && bun run --filter @fitia/mcp build && bun run --filter @fitia/selfhost build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @fitia/core typecheck && bun run --filter @fitia/cli typecheck && bun run --filter @fitia/mcp typecheck && bun run --filter @fitia/selfhost typecheck && bun x tsc -p dev/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test
scripts.clean: bun run --filter @fitia/core clean && bun run --filter @fitia/cli clean && bun run --filter @fitia/mcp clean && bun run --filter @fitia/selfhost clean
